text: “If ever there was a woman who made small claims--!” “You put your finger on it,” Ralph interrupted. “Her modesty’s exaggerated. She has no business with small claims--she has a perfect right to make large ones.” “Her merits are large then. You contradict yourself.” “Her merits are immense,” said Ralph. “She’s indescribably blameless; a pathless desert of virtue; the only woman I know who never gives one a chance.” “A chance for what?” “Well, say to call her a fool!
